Installation

Requirements

  • Windows

  • Python 3.12

  • Python virtual environment

  • Ollama

  • Snowflake account

  • Git

Create Virtual Environment

python -m venv bmwvenv

Activate Environment

PowerShell:

.\bmwvenv\Scripts\Activate.ps1

Install Project

python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

Verify Installation

python -c "import bmw_analyst; print('BMW Analyst import successful')"

Configure Environment

Create the project .env file and configure the required Snowflake, Ollama, API and application settings.

Run Tests

python -m pytest -q -m "not integration"

Run FastAPI

python -m uvicorn bmw_analyst.api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload

Run Streamlit

streamlit run ui\streamlit_app.py
